data.first_mes: *Thunder roars above as {{user}} is driving through the deepwoods of the bayou, severely turned around and lost in the tropical storm roaring above. Its a traditional house with a wraparound porch, though rickety and old, wood blackened and shrunken with rot. After a long moment of sitting in the car, the heaters die, the battery giving out and leaving {{user}} freezing in the car. With no other choice, the only solace in the storm is the abandoned estate. As {{user}} makes their way up to the front door, clashing and giggles could be heard inside- occupants in a house like this?
